overall_assessment:
One low evidence-integrity finding, CP63-FINAL-01; no high or medium defect established in the delivered static-policy delta. The source and candidate are suitable for the planned guarded local Web activation after the finding is resolved. Public delivery has not been demonstrated, so this is not DOD-09/VAL-09 completion, parent closure, legal certification, Meta publication approval, or permission to admit another user cohort.

Scope and adherence: I read the complete dispatch and bounded package, verified package SHA-256 04803596492494eb29395d1cc99ad68a22129cfc9e11820e4f524207f1cecf58, and reviewed the final asset, reconverged facts, critique/adjudication, governing cp63 TODO sections, constitution, scope policy, module ownership, source excerpts, validation logs, candidate evidence, corrected commands and terminal layout/provenance supplements. Active profile is Assurance / Tester-Quality with react, vite and docker scope; Genesis does not apply. Web HEAD 34408c47b4f2f935291d5fc9934f5118b5516bd4 and API HEAD db5a86758a165fac8a1ab587599c37b17890530c match the packet. Read-only Web status shows only the new public/privacidade.html. D11 is implemented faithfully as one institutional static document; project_constitution.md:30, scope_subscope_governance.md:19 and integrations-and-channels.md:88-94 explicitly own the public surface without changing API, tenant, BU or authentication contracts. The authorized prepare/host instructions are preserved without inventing an APROVADO reply.

Factuality and security: the complete policy accurately limits server-side encryption to persisted official access tokens, distinguishes password hashing, discloses contact/message content in redacted webhook diagnostics, scopes the implemented periodic 90-day purge to API webhook records, and distinguishes persistent conversations and provider/cache stores with unproved effective retention. Public source supports the signed 24-hour session, browser preferences, conditional Meta SDK, optional uploads/email/automation and configured provider persistence. The text describes a manual email request process rather than an automatic erasure capability. UNIFAST/contact are human statements; actual mailbox delivery, detailed legal roles/bases, contracts and transfer mechanisms remain unverified. No company number, address, DPO appointment, country, backup practice, universal erasure guarantee or Meta approval was invented. I did not perform a legal-compliance assessment or visit external links. The page contains no executable script, form, SDK, analytics, account lookup or backend call. Its early CSP meta, no-referrer policy and click-only external links are proportionate for this public static content; noindex is not an access-control claim.

Evidence and test-audit sufficiency: source and accepted manuscript hash equally to d0f72c588f0f014de46a327e34d6b26125ca115bc973b56bbb926cd8519e701d. The canonical Web runner's unchanged raw log verifies a real successful 58-module Vite build and 28 tests across five files; its ephemeral output is correctly not used as source/dist proof. The separate Docker candidate build completed and produced image sha256:6f4b2500e02d1523f99b423a08b6a166e319d5f3246ad516ef8f4a56d30001ed. Candidate HTTP reports a no-session, no-redirect 200 text/html response with 12,865 valid UTF-8 bytes exactly matching the source, UTF-8 meta and no Set-Cookie. I verified the supplied artifact hashes against the files. Actual old/candidate runtime-layer and Nginx/template/entrypoint comparisons and JS d14343604557296f2ed62c1df47d9c80d81c323abafd89ccbb64a6a0746ff4bd equality are separate evidence for preserved serving behavior.

The terminal layout supplement SHA-256 51e1761fe9d026b823a0f65f7e5fde4956fbc776549a4435bcc824f6fcf8699b closes the earlier candidate-layout gap. I checked both screenshot hashes and viewed both complete screenshots: content is readable without clipping. Measured inner widths and document/body widths are 375 and 1280 respectively; both runs report the exact policy response hash, ten sections, three mailto links, three external anchors with noreferrer, one page request, no external resource requests, and no console/page errors. The initial default-1280px mobile attempt is explicitly disqualified in artifacts/tmp/number-onboarding-execution/T/cp63-layout-first-pass.json; it contributes no passing evidence. Isolated tooling does not change project dependencies, product runners or runtime services. These are candidate observations, not public-host observations.

The provenance correction JSON SHA-256 73d7ac9d0d1e8eb1f4456a8003d6205ed27066b3248da990e9fe4a0ccfa561a9 honestly supersedes the original malformed 63-hex node ID and the candidate's overbroad sameBeforeAfter=true interpretation. Matching repository digest, a current valid 64-hex ID, cached builder steps and absence of --pull do not prove an immutable resolved FROM digest or exact pre/post local-ID equality. The raw build log prints only tags. That remaining historical attribution limit is acceptable for this bounded static delta given the unchanged source, separate actual runtime and JavaScript equivalence, and explicit qualification; do not turn it back into an exact-base claim. CP63-FINAL-01 concerns the correction note's stale checksum, not evidence of a base change or a product defect.

Composition and rule spirit: all nine inspected cp36j manifest entries still hash-match; the manifest and accepted full TQA j/final j raw hashes match the bounded packet. No test assertions, fixtures or runners changed in this delta. Reusing those audits only for unchanged behavior, while supplying direct factual/security/build/HTTP/layout evidence and this distinct final for D11, is proportionate. Mirrored-text tests would add little assurance here. The big/cross-stack floor remains intact; no fresh all537, browser-j, newly served API-j or blanket regression claim is justified. I found no new pipeline P1/P2 implementation defect, hidden runtime overlay, fake receipt, SQL status promotion, broad restart, test-expectation weakening, guard bypass or other rule-spirit shortcut in the scoped delivery.

Positions: performance is acceptable: a 12,865-byte static page with no application/API/DB work and one observed document request introduces no identified performance regression; this is not load/SLO evidence. Elegance is strong_positive: native Vite public assets and existing Nginx routing satisfy the approved intent without another framework, endpoint, dependency or deletion subsystem. Structural soundness is acceptable: one owned document, explicit public/auth boundaries and the canonical build path add no brittle product workaround or business-logic duplication. Operational fit is mixed until actual activation/probe: corrected Windows Compose argv are Web-only, and the candidate is verified, but the temporary tunnel has no demonstrated supervisor/restart guarantee and static gateway resolution may become stale after Web recreation. These are explicitly bounded existing risks, not silently waived defects.

Residual gates and debt: official VAL-05 remains open and unwaived; SUBSCRIBED/PENDING_RECEIPT and the panel's synthetic 200 do not establish real official IN/OUT or recovery. Existing dependency debt BLG-leadshug-runtime-dependency-security remains due before untrusted authenticated users; full npm-install audit counts are not a replacement for the earlier production-scope reachability diagnostic. This static publication grants no broader access or production readiness. Seven live containers/five volumes and owned probe cleanup are executor evidence, not a runtime inspection I performed. No network, tests, runtime commands, private environment, cookies, provider payloads or private operational data files were accessed during this review; no product, canonical document or Git state was changed. Only the delegated result file was written.
recommended_path: Integrate CP63-FINAL-01 by correcting or appending a precise hash-bound reference to the terminal provenance JSON, preserving original preparation/candidate raw artifacts. A checksum-reference-only correction needs no product change or repeated build/unit/browser run. Subject to that evidence reconciliation and the orchestrator's normal authority/adherence checks, accept the exact candidate for the already authorized local Web-only step. Before recreation, attest the locally committed asset bytes, preserve the actual old Web image, bind the Compose tag to candidate image 6f4b2500e02d1523f99b423a08b6a166e319d5f3246ad516ef8f4a56d30001ed and verify those tags. Use the corrected Windows --env-file/manifests and --no-build --no-deps --force-recreate web command. Then require actual public normal-TLS no-session/no-redirect 200, text/html, valid UTF-8/meta, exact policy bytes, no Set-Cookie, root/health/JS comparisons and preservation of other resources before delivering the URL. Keep D11's delivery exception and DOD-09/VAL-09 open until that proof exists. Stop on gateway/tunnel/probe failure before separately adjudicated remediation; no implicit gateway reload, broad service restart or tunnel rotation is authorized. Retain the provenance limitation, private cohort/dependency debt and parent Pending/official VAL-05 unwaived status. A proved URL permits the operator's Meta preparation only; app publication, source push and production remain outside this slice.

findings.title: The provenance correction note cites an obsolete diagnostic checksum
findings.rationale: Evidence: cp63-web-build-provenance.md:7 identifies the JSON with SHA-256 79f77613a4f804a0ca25181e614159b771b1a2b3aa0ca98a8d719f03f52f0e1f. The actual terminal cp63-web-build-provenance.json hashes to 73d7ac9d0d1e8eb1f4456a8003d6205ed27066b3248da990e9fe4a0ccfa561a9, matching the root's terminal supplement; its line 38 carries the important qualification of the original candidate boolean. The Markdown file's own supplied hash matches, so this is a stale embedded reference rather than a read mismatch. Why now: the note is being admitted as the correction that prevents an unsupported exact-base provenance claim; following its checksum cannot validate the actual corrected evidence. The JSON qualification itself is sound, and no product, layout, security or build defect follows from this reference error.
findings.suggested_action: Correct the note's JSON reference to the actual terminal checksum, or append an explicit hash-bound erratum if preserving the already-dispatched note as immutable evidence. Keep the malformed preparation record and original candidate artifact intact, and retain the limitation that exact pre/post Node local-ID equality and a resolved build-log digest were not proven. Refresh the note/receipt hash in the final evidence index. No source edit, image rebuild, test rerun, new base pin or expanded scope is required for this correction.
